// Package unformatted holds the shapes gofmt rewrites, a parenthesized if condition, which it strips, and doubled
// parentheses, which it folds, for the original and the port to agree on as the parser hands them over.
package unformatted

func parenthesized(value bool) bool {
	if (value) {
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func parenthesizedComparison(a, b int) bool {
	if ((a > b)) {
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func parenthesizedLength(text string) bool {
	if (len(text) > 0) {
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func parenthesizedAnd(a, b bool) bool {
	if ((a && b)) {
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func parenthesizedNot(value bool) bool {
	if (!value) {
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func parenthesizedSelector(each struct{ ready bool }) bool {
	if (each.ready) {
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func doubledResults(value bool) bool {
	if value {
		return ((false))
	}
	return ((true))
}

func oneLine(value bool) bool {
	if value { return true }; return false
}
